027.title: Dr. Cake
027.intro: Waffle has played in the water for too long, which caused a harmless little 'coldiness' sensation of a sneeze and shiver. That is more than enough for Dr. Cake to step onto the scene.
027.plot: After the whole bath arc, reality catches up to Waffle's shenanigans. Harmlessly so, in the form of a slight sneeze that tells him he spent too much time in the water. Cake immediately steps in to handle the issue by making Waffle as cozy as possible, ensuring he gets all he needs and beyond.
027.behindTheScenes: Given that illnesses can't exist in their realm, this condition Waffle has could cause confusion. But it is merely a little rule-of-reality sensation that tells him that perhaps he can put his time into other things too, while viewers can relate it to the common cold in real life, which is far less pleasant.

026.title: Cute-a-geddon
026.intro: Fluff and Bun are at their rivalry again with a device they found in the Gnome Village while Cake's curiosity is unsupervised. Oh dear.

025.title: Raptor Training
025.intro: Fluff has decided that it's time for Waffle to become a proper raptor, like in the movies. So training is underway.

024.title: Waffle's new hoodie
024.intro: Waffle got a hip new hoodie. But it has drawstrings which means Bun must pull.

023.title: Waffle likes bath
023.intro: Waffle is still in the pond. Turns out he likes bath just not getting into it. Cake is once more trying to fix things.

022.title: Magic Spring
022.intro: Fluff found a magic spring that makes you fluffy. Bun is obviously not going to miss out on that.

021.title: Bath Time
021.intro: After playing all day long the time has come for a bath. But Waffle is not very keen on getting into the water.

020.title: Mystery Time
020.intro: Someone ate the cake! A team of legendary detectives is working on the case.

019.title: The Usual
019.intro: There is no need to even wonder what to take for breakfast when your favorite cereal is in stock.

018.title: New Spookiness
018.intro: The spooky season has arrived and it is all new for Waffle.

017.title: Waffle
017.intro: The great moment has finally arrived. The great happiness in the Cozy Realm was high enough so a new Serafim has arrived to join the trio! Fun fact: Waffle predates these series as he was originally designed to be a cute and rascally pet in my android game I never ended up creating.

016.title: Neighbours
016.intro: It appears that Cake has found something. Since she loves to read books about dragons, this is a big and exciting discovery for her.

015.title: Weekends
015.intro: Sometimes it's best to get all your favorite things in one place and take a break.

014.title: Hidden Cake
014.intro: Cake finally tried to make her first ever cake. But she does not seem impressed how it turned out.

013.title: Print Time
013.intro: They found a 3d printer in Tinkerhat's workshop! Time to make fun figurines with it I guess.

012.title: Always good
012.intro: Fluff is getting picky today and Cake is is here to help. Whatever will Fluff choose?

011.title: A New Egg
011.intro: Cake has found a Celestimal egg! This is huge news for the trio. It means a fourth Serafim is to join them soon! Who could it be?

010.title: Much Sleepiness
010.intro: Morning is here and lots of games are to be played. But Cake is still sleepy.

009.title: It Blends
009.intro: Cake is up to something and she's got a blender. Bun and Fluff must investigate.

008.title: Even Better
008.intro: It's time to get up and Cake is already here to welcome Fluff. Cake also wants to offer breakfast but due to shortage a replacement is in order. Hopefully Fluff does not mind the alternative.

007.title: Bun Appetite
007.intro: When Bun is up to something she is a force to be reckoned with.

006.title: Fast Cake
006.intro: Munching pretzels a moment ago and speeding by on a superbike the next. Cake is quite unpredictable. She must have found it in Tinkerhat's yard.

005.title: Cotton Candy
005.intro: Cotton Candy season is here and Fluff already found one in the fields. But these are always troublesome to eat when you are fluffy. But fear not Bun is here to help!

004.title: Pro-cat-ination
004.intro: Fluff has decided that its important to study so she borrowed some cool sounding books from Scribes the librarian gnome. But Cake is not very keen on her academic endeavours at the moment.
004.plot:
Fluff decided that they must study because it's important for some reason. So she decides to check if Cake has finished studying. Cake, being a dreamer, has obviously wandered off in her thoughts about many things she likes to think about, which prompts Fluff to pull her out of it. Cake, of course, decides to use her trump card and behave like a kitten, which fails to phase Fluff. 

This introduced a notable behavior by Cake, where she tends to avoid responsibility by acting cute. 

The questionable selection of books is left as a mystery for the time being, with intent for clarification in a future season 2 episode.
004.behindTheScenes: This episode was the first time Cake was drawn for an episode given episode 2 was drawn later.

003.title: Pillow Attac
003.intro: It's a brand new day and Bun is up to something. Whatever mischievous things does she plot?
003.plot:
Bun is up to something, and her expression gives it away. Fluff fails to finish her sentence before she is hit with a pillow. She gives chase to return the favor to the mischievous bunny. 

This introduced the running gag where the two like playing pillow fights, with Bun being the one to start it most of the time.
003.behindTheScenes: This is the very first episode ever drawn. It was drawn in spring 2023 and it marks the first ever art of Fluff and Bun inside an episode. Though they were drawn before in a concept art piece.

002.title: The First Ever
002.intro: The messengers of fun are finally here! The valley is about to be much more interesting from now on with this trio around. Lots of hijinks and play ahead. Join them in the following episodes as they discover the world around them and have fun everywhere!
002.plot:
The episode depicts the iconic arival of titular Serafimz characters. They materialise in their eggs and pop out introducing themselves. A pun is played on Cake's name when she announces it, making Bun mistake it for a real cake and ask for its location. Nevertheless, Cake does show that there is indeed a cake and points in its direction. 

Given Cake always pronounces 'cake' with a cutified shortened word such as cak' (pronounced 'kek'), it means she did say her name rather than state she noticed a cake. The gnomes are suprisingly absent during their arrival due to their very shy nature and likely desire to let Serafimz intially acustomise themselves in the meadow.
002.behindTheScenes: This is the episode that introduced the main trio to the world. It was drawn in GIMP software. While it did not explain the origin of the birthday cake, it was established that Gnomes made it behind the scenes. Later a prologue was drawn to correct this before the series was published online.

001.title: The Prologue
001.intro: The official beginning of the Smol Serafimz story! In a cozy care free world where many beings live in harmony, a question arises among the gnomes if anything is amiss in their eternal journey. The Primordial was already aware of this so he sent his little agents to remedy the situation.
001.plot:
The story opens with a narration that states how Gnomes wondered if their world was perfect, given that they already live carefree lives. It depicts Beardy sweeping leaves along the road that leads out of the Gnome Village. Following panels display two more gnomes, Mittens in his bakery and Tinkerhat in his workshop, while narration continues. The comic ends with a reveal that their very question was already answered by a higher power (The Primordial), who introduced 3 eggs to the realm. 

Meaning that Gnomes were right to feel something was missing, and the solution will arrive via new beings whose nature brings the missing feature. That being playful, cuteness and fun.
001.behindTheScenes:
This episode was drawn after episodes 2-20 & 21 to serve as the prologue for the series. It is also the first episode to be drawn in Krita software. It introduced the gnomes and the locations in their village, while their concepts were already long established in the comic behind the scenes. 

While original episodes were drawn in 2023, this one was made in 2026 after a haitus when the creator finally decided to publish the comic.
